[EVENT] User is interested in taking a workshop focused on inversions and arm balances.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for preparing for the workshop include strength-building exercises and flexibility stretches.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Strength-building exercises include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Plank: Hold for 30-60 seconds, rest for 30 seconds, repeat for 3-5 sets.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Chaturanga: Practice chaturanga push-ups for 3 sets of 10-15 reps.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Inverted rows: Use a resistance band or light dumbbell.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Core exercises: Bicycle crunches, Russian twists, leg raises.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Flexibility and mobility exercises include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Shoulder openers: Shoulder rolls, shoulder blade squeezes, arm circles.
